Observability company groundcover Inc. today announced the launch of Agent Investigations, a shared workspace designed to allow groundcover’s artificial intelligence agents, a team’s own coding agents and on-call engineers to work production incidents together. Agent Investigations is aimed at the problem of scattered findings as AI agents take on a bigger role in incident response. […]

The post Groundcover launches Agent Investigations, a shared workspace for AI agents and engineers appeared first on SiliconANGLE.
